testing_summary: Disposable stack preparation and focused tests passed. Three live browser scenarios verified persistent AJAX changes, concurrent feedback, rejection recovery, and retry; screenshots and response transcripts were captured, then the stack and transient fixtures were removed.

scenarios.name: On the disposable local product, exclude and restore HU: feedback appears without navigation, and both states survive full reloads.
Save HU and CZ concurrently on a synthetic photo: each checkbox locks while saving and retains independent market feedback.
Submit an invalid security token locally: HTTP 403 restores the checkbox, preserves its error when another market saves, and permits a successful retry without navigation.
